conceptual_real_printed_mass_kg.basis: 0.55-0.75 closed sections, 0.50-0.70 ribbed plates/bed/carriers, 0.65-0.85 local interfaces; no slicer or hardware mass.

contributions.method: Closed-section equivalent over the 280 mm P2 clear span.

contributions.method: Equivalent moving X carriage, Z plate, guide, and spindle interface stiffness.

contributions.method: Equivalent closed base and tower-foot stiffness; rail datum excluded here.

contributions.method: Equivalent ribbed bed/support compliance at the PCB datum.
